correction: The earlier claim that missing leave_days visibly displays NaN was incorrect. metricCard already renders non-finite values as Not reported. Null/negative/fractional totals can still display numeric values while the per-unit monthly display treats those values as unavailable.
recommendation: Optional separate frontend follow-up: compute a shared unit leave-day display value for initial render and retained refresh. Return undefined unless each returned summary has its own finite nonnegative integer leave_days field. Otherwise return the sum. Pass undefined to existing metricCard so the existing Not reported presentation is reused. Do not coerce missing/null to zero or change any response/persisted data. Preserve current empty-summary behavior unless an explicit completeness contract is established.
proposed_pure_helper: function unitLeaveDayMetric(rows: UnitManagementMonth["unit_summaries"]): number | undefined { return rows.every(row => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, "leave_days") && Number.isInteger(row.leave_days) && row.leave_days >= 0) ? rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.leave_days, 0) : undefined; }
limitations: Pure evidence uses the exact current metricCard function with simple escaping/label stubs; no browser executed.
This is a recommendation only, not a V4 applied change or acceptance claim.
No assumption made that every listed unit must appear in unit_summaries; establishing missing-group completeness would require separate contract evidence.
